item.text:
Current standard API prices per **1 million tokens (USD)**, as of **October 18, 2026**:

| Provider | Flagship model | Input | Output |
|---|---|---:|---:|
| Anthropic | Claude Opus 5.5 | $4 | $20 |
| OpenAI | GPT-6 Astra, short context | $10 | $50 |
| Google | Gemini 4 Argon, Standard tier | $2 | $10 |

Anthropic describes Opus 5.5 as its strongest Opus model. [Anthropic pricing](https://www.anthropic.com/claude/opus) OpenAI identifies GPT-6 Astra as its flagship for complex reasoning and coding; its price is higher for long-context requests. [OpenAI model catalog](https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/models) · [OpenAI API pricing](https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/pricing) Google labels Gemini 4 Argon its flagship reasoning model; the listed Standard rate is $2/$10 through November 30, 2026, then doubles on December 1. [Google Gemini API pricing](https://ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/pricing)

These are list rates before any caching, batch, or other tier adjustments. OpenAI’s long-context Astra rate is $20 input and $75 output per million tokens.
